process_description: CANONICAL create a new external mapping for a Semptify entity. CANONICAL list user's external mappings with optional type and status filters. CANONICAL get a specific external mapping by ID. CANONICAL update the status of an external mapping. CANONICAL create a court case external mapping. CANONICAL list court case mappings with optional case_type and case_status filters. CANONICAL create a property external mapping. CANONICAL list property mappings with optional county and is_primary filters. CANONICAL create an agency external mapping. CANONICAL list agency mappings with optional agency_code and complaint_type filters. CANONICAL search across all external mappings by query with optional type filter.
